convention: \paragraph{Empty-family conventions.} For finite families of nonnegative integers we use $\max\varnothing=0$. The height of an empty finite partially ordered set is $0$, as is the height of a nonempty poset with no strict comparable pair. Thus the height in the support-preorder theorem counts strict steps.
